basis: master abf1195. Re-scored by agent MILESTONES2 from the repo docs, git log and an offline go test run (internal/task, boss, quest, questmem: ok); nothing here was run live by MILESTONES2. A criterion is done only with a doc that names a live run (instance, date) or a CI/offline-by-nature check.

statuses.todo: not started, or code exists but nothing about it is verified
statuses.partial: code exists and is tested offline, or verified live only in part (a tool, a probe, a short run), or a live run is in progress but not recorded in a doc
statuses.done: verified live (doc names the run, instance and date) or by CI; offline tests alone never make a criterion done unless the criterion itself is an offline one

rollup.percent: sum of weights of the milestone's criteria / number of criteria, rounded down
rollup.milestone_status: done if every criterion is done; todo if every criterion is todo; partial otherwise
rollup.gate_status: a gate covers its own milestones plus those of the gates it includes (beta includes alpha, goodbot includes beta); it is passed when all of them are done; its percent is the mean of their percents
rollup.evidence_rule: a criterion may only move to done in the same commit that adds the evidence note (doc path + run/instance/date, soak report path, or CI run)

gates.title: Alpha: a reliable Act 1 bot on the product path
gates.summary: A fresh level-1 character, started through the product path (one d2bot --managed per host, no setcap, sentinel in the product topology), levels in Normal Act 1, completes Act 1 including Andariel, hops to Act 2, and the same setup survives 24 h unattended with <= 1 death per hour and 0 human interventions.

gates.title: Beta: Normal complete, installable by a friend
gates.summary: Alpha plus: Normal Acts 2-5 and the hop to Nightmare unattended; a headless container plus setup wizard that someone other than the user and the agents can install with their own game files; 72 h soak with 0 manual restarts.

gates.title: Good-bot gate: the game layer may start
gates.summary: Beta plus: Nightmare and Hell playthroughs, farming runs at a sane rate, a 7-day soak, handicap profiles proven live, and the second class. Only then are upgrades, prestige, cheats-as-rewards and parties-as-feature built.

milestones.title: Party of 2-4 bots on one host
milestones.why: Fleet and party code exist offline and the loopback join is proven live (docs/net/multiplayer.md section 9); invite/party formation, roles and four bots are not. Multiplies every reliability problem, so it waits for a reliable single bot.

criteria.text: Two instances join one TCP/IP game over loopback (host + join), both readable and controllable
criteria.measure: two players in one game from memory
criteria.evidence: V docs/net/multiplayer.md section 9 (PARTYLIVE, i1 Navi host, i2 Combi joiner, 2026-10-28): two Wine prefixes join one TCP/IP game over 127.0.0.1, both characters in both unit hash tables and rosters, join takes about 5 s (one of about 8 took over 2 minutes). Joining does NOT form a party (partyid 65535). XP split on a kill not measured.

criteria.text: Fleet supervisor adds and removes slots at runtime on a live host (launch.Life), admission refuses past capacity

criteria.evidence: internal/fleet + party with a fake runtime (docs/fleet.md); party.FlowDriver host/join is live on i1+i2 (multiplayer.md 9). Missing: fleet add/remove on a live host and admission by capacity.

milestones.title: Game layer: upgrades and progression UI
milestones.why: The idle game itself: the bot starts handicapped and the player buys upgrades (Tuning knobs) with currency earned from measured play. Parked by the user until the gate; the data contract (knob metadata, goals.Upgrade) already exists so the UI can iterate freely.

criteria.text: Design doc grounded in measured telemetry (what a knob is worth in XP/h)
criteria.evidence: Prior art collected (docs/archive/prior-art/meta).

criteria.text: Upgrade tree UI rendered from data; buying an upgrade changes a knob live

milestones.title: Game layer: hardcore as prestige (rebirth)
milestones.why: Hardcore death resets the run and pays permanent bonuses. Kept possible since day one (character mode lives in bot.Policy, PLAN 'Decisions'); built only after the softcore bot is good.

criteria.text: Hardcore run ends on death, prestige currency paid, new character created by the OOG flow

milestones.title: Game layer: cheats as rewards

milestones.title: Showcase: stream, scene and public status
milestones.why: Not part of bot quality, so it gates nothing and is not in a gate rollup. It is how the project is watched: Kick stream of live games, a scene page, a public status page. Most of it is Python/shell tooling verified by mock tests; the live pieces are thin. Kept on the board so it does not pretend to be bot progress.
